override.reason: The length is imposed by the checklist data model, not by the author, and this change made both imperatives strictly SHORTER (context lost one sentence, admiral latitude lost one clause). Flagging it would be flagging the schema, and the diff moves in the smell's favour.

smells.finding: No class or module gained responsibilities. scripts/episode_capture.py changed comments only; the two spine templates shed content.

The synthetic durable declaration literal `.agent-work/synthetic-durable.md` is written out 4 times in tests/test_episode_capture.py (grep -c 'synthetic-durable.md' -> 4), with the {root, path, required} entry dict spelled out twice. A module-level constant would let the root-resolution tests share one fixture. Recorded as an OBSERVATION, not a blocker: four literals in one test class is a small cost, and see the speculative-generality row for why I did not push harder.
No method reaches into another object's data. The tests call cm.resolve/ec.resolve_roots through their public seams, which is the documented interface-is-the-test-surface rule.
The {root, path, required} triple travels together everywhere, but it is already a named declaration entry validated by context_manifest, not an ad-hoc clump this change introduced.
No new primitives stand in for a concept. Paths remain Path objects; the root token stays a member of cm.ROOT_TOKENS.
No signature changed anywhere in the diff.

This is the real smell of the change and it is worth naming even though it is not a defect in the change. One conceptual decision -- 'a live agent no longer reads the lessons bank' -- required edits in five separate files phrased five different ways (a SKILL.md bullet, two JSON imperatives, a markdown template placeholder, a docs bullet), and a sixth mechanical declaration. That is exactly why the acceptance guard has to enumerate-then-classify rather than grep one phrase, and it is why my r7 enumeration by a different route was worth running. The remedy is not available to this gate: the doctrine is deliberately restated per audience.
No single file is changing for many unrelated reasons; each of the eight files changed for exactly this one reason.
The one chain-shaped expression, `json.loads(...)['tasks']['context']['context_refs']` in the reworked test, is indexing a JSON document, not navigating an object graph, and it predates this change.

The `durable` root token now has ZERO shipped declarations corpus-wide (git grep '"root": "durable"' -- skills/ returns nothing), and three tests plus a fixture now exist purely to exercise a code path no shipped data reaches. By the deletion test this looks like generality kept on speculation.

override.repo_standard: skills/_shared/global-everyone.md, 'Verify claimed side-effects against the world' and the fail-visibly posture: the trap being guarded is SILENT (a wrong durable root records rev: null without raising), so removing the guard removes the only detector. override.reason: The tests are not speculative generality in the production code -- the production code did not gain an extension point; only the fixture became synthetic. Deleting them would delete the sole detector for a failure mode that produces a plausible-looking manifest with every rev null. The implementer additionally surfaced the token's future as an explicit decision candidate rather than leaving it implicit, which is the sanctioned handling.
